title: Free meeting slots from messy calendars
requirements: free_slots(busy, start, end, minutes) returns the free ('HH:MM', 'HH:MM') windows between start and end that are at least `minutes` long, in time order
Busy blocks may be unsorted and may overlap each other
Busy blocks reaching outside the day are clipped to it (blocks entirely outside are ignored), and a free window exactly `minutes` long counts
user_messages: slots.free_slots(busy, start, end, minutes) → free ('HH:MM', 'HH:MM') windows between start and end that are at least `minutes` long, in order
busy blocks come straight from people's calendars so they can be out of order and overlap
a meeting can stick out past the start or end of the day — clip it, and ignore ones completely outside. and a gap of exactly `minutes` is fine, that's the case people complain about
